summary: Cayson Acquisition Corp, a blank-check SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting it deposited a monthly extension contribution into its trust account. On May 21, 2026, sponsors/insiders contributed $125,000 for the third monthly extension under a previously approved amendment allowing up to 12 monthly extensions until March 23, 2027. No business combination has been announced. The filing is a routine trust deposit update, not a special-situation event. Watch for whether the SPAC announces a target or faces liquidation if no deal is completed by the extended deadline.
